features.title: Visible whitespace, EOL, and control characters

Indicator toggles do not change document bytes, selection, or undo history.

command_mapping_rules.rationale: Namespace bases, dynamic ranges, menu containers, positions, or sentinels are not invokable user commands.
Headless export-and-quit maintenance entry is not an interactive editing workflow; exclusion remains provisional until an independent reviewer approves it.
These entries target Notepad++-specific support, update, and diagnostic destinations; Duckpad owns separate product workflows and exclusion remains provisional until independent review.
Windows system-tray lifecycle has no required editor-parity result on macOS; exclusion remains provisional until independent review.
Internal shortcut-XML validation is a maintenance command rather than an end-user editing workflow; exclusion remains provisional until independent review.
Windows system-tray activation and close commands have no required editor-parity result on macOS; exclusion remains provisional until independent review.
